scope.subject: MATHEMATICAL_RESULTS_GUIDE.md
scope.purpose: bind one exact 23-page Ubuntu/x86 candidate for the current source-specific cross-toolchain dispatcher before a separate hosted replay

font_supply_deviation_from_hosted_ci.reason: the 629 MB package download was unavailable within the local capture window
font_supply_deviation_from_hosted_ci.substitution_scope: only the three Source Sans Pro OTF faces resolved by this guide were injected at their TeX paths; all other named PDF fonts came from the installed packages
font_supply_deviation_from_hosted_ci.consequence: this is a CI-matched translated local candidate, not a claim that the complete hosted package filesystem was reproduced

repeatability_observations.each_builder_internal_acceptance_relatio: raw byte identity or the separately pinned strict duplicated final-trailer ID relation

profile_adjudication.candidate_relation: a future candidate must equal the retained fixture byte-for-byte or have the same length and differ solely in both duplicated 16-byte payloads of its final trailer ID array; both complete strict v2 structure reports must also agree
profile_adjudication.exact_mode_boundary: same-toolchain exact mode remains a strict raw byte comparison and does not read, select, or invoke this cross-toolchain fixture, receipt, checker, or exception relation
profile_adjudication.historical_boundary: the frozen 16-page v1 raw fixture, checker, self-test, and receipt remain separate historical evidence and are not overwritten or promoted to the current profile
profile_adjudication.canonical_cross_toolchain_boundary: the current committed macOS PDF and this Ubuntu candidate are not declared raw-equivalent; the outer dispatcher separately requires exact text, geometry, font-roster, target, navigation, and strict per-PDF structure checks

hosted_replay.required_next_step: publish the exact reviewed profile files, run the current cross-toolchain gate on a GitHub-hosted Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64 runner, retain its log and candidate identity, and update this receipt only from that direct evidence

custody_boundaries: the translated local run provides strong candidate and comparison evidence but is not a GitHub-hosted execution
the local Docker image is an unauthenticated, locally assembled environment and is not retained as a registry artifact
the omitted texlive-fonts-extra package and exact three-face substitution are disclosed; hosted CI remains the decisive package-environment replay
the retained PDF is byte-bound, but the complete container filesystem, process image, and host kernel state are not retained
the current profile accepts no arbitrary metadata, object-order, compression, numeric, font-resource, text, navigation, or structure differences
the strict trailer-ID exception applies only to equal-length PDFs with exactly the two duplicated final-trailer payload differences certified by the separately digest-pinned checker
normal and optimized Python agreement is bounded mutation evidence, not a formal implementation proof, mutation completeness result, or authentication claim
the result is source-specific and does not establish general Pandoc, TeX Live, renderer, operating-system, or future-run equivalence
the result does not establish PDF/UA conformance, mathematical correctness, estimator validity, statistical validity, scientific novelty, or application suitability
